data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the Refresh that runs before a Trial or Review check cannot finish. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalRefreshCancelledCode
data.value: Cancelled, so nothing was checked. The Refresh already started carries on until it finishes.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the person cancels a check while the Refresh before it is running. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalRefreshUnavailableCode
data.value: The project cannot be refreshed while other work is running, so nothing was checked. Try again when it has finished.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the Refresh before a check cannot start because parsing or another Refresh holds the project. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalTrialNothingPending
data.value: There are no changes to check.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.TrialNothingPending. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalTrialProposalGone
data.value: Those changes were removed or replaced just now, so they were not checked.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.TrialProposalGone. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalTrialUpdateInProgress
data.value: Motif is installing an update. Try the check again in a moment.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.TrialUpdateInProgress. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalWordTraceCancelled
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.WordTraceCancelled. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalWordTraceMalformedDiagnostic
data.value: That file is not a diagnostic Motif can read. Choose a diagnostic Motif saved.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.WordTraceMalformedDiagnostic. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalWordTraceNoBaseline
data.value: Refresh the project before trying a word.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.WordTraceNoBaseline. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalWordTraceParserRefused

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedWordsPattern
data.comment: Count sentence on the Overview Speed tile: how many words PanGloss counted parser work for. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedMainFormat
data.comment: Headline of the Overview Speed tile. {0} is the count of words the parser counted work for, such as "142 words"; {1} is the total of each word's parser work with their unit, such as "38,000 parser work".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedNoTimes
data.comment: Overview Speed tile headline when no parser work are stored.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedMedianFormat
data.comment: Overview Speed tile: the median parser work per word. {0} is a count with its unit, such as "64 parser work".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedElapsedFormat
data.comment: Overview Speed tile: how long the whole run took, a time that depends on the speed of this computer; {0} is a duration such as "38.0 s".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedMedianWithPercentileFormat
data.comment: Overview Speed tile: the median and 95th percentile parser work per word. {0} and {1} are counts with their unit, such as "64 parser work".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedStoppedPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# stopped at the work limit} other {# stopped at the work limit}}
data.comment: Count sentence on the Overview Speed tile: how many words stopped at the parser work limit. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestSummaryFormat
data.comment: Overview summary of the slowest words. {0} is the list of words with their parser work.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestWordFormat
data.comment: One slowest word in the Overview summary. {0} is the word; {1} is its parser work with their unit.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestStoppedWordFormat
data.comment: One slowest word that stopped at the work limit. {0} is the word; {1} is its parser work with their unit. Stopped is the name of an outcome.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParsed
data.comment: Outcome word on the Try a Word page: PanGloss built at least one analysis.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSearchIncomplete
data.comment: Outcome word on the Try a Word page: the parser search stopped before it finished.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysesPattern
data.comment: Count sentence on the Try a Word page: how many analyses the trace found. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSourceRecordsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# source record} other {# source records}}
data.comment: Count sentence on the Try a Word page: how many parser records the analyses came from. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysesWithRecordsFormat
data.comment: Try a Word analyses heading when records repeat. {0} is the analysis count sentence; {1} is the source record count sentence.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParsedAnalysesFormat
data.comment: Try a Word analyses heading for a parsed word. {0} is the analysis count sentence, such as "2 analyses".

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysisAttemptsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# analysis attempt} other {# analysis attempts}}
data.comment: Count sentence in the Try a Word trace summary: how many analysis attempts the parser made. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceGuessed
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part: the parser guessed the word's stem.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceOverallFormat
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part. {0} is the overall duration of the trace.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceOverallNotRecorded
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part: no overall duration was recorded.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceInParserFormat
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part. {0} is the parser work as a count of parser work; {1} is the overall time sentence.

data.name: MotifApp.ParserWorkFormat
data.comment: Try a Word line giving the parser work. {0} is a count of parser work, such as 1,234 parser work.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParserWorkNotRecorded
data.comment: Try a Word line shown when the trace did not record its parser work.

data.name: MotifApp.ParserWorkPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# parser work} other {# parser work}}
data.comment: Count of parser work. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.ParserWorkNotRecorded
data.comment: Summary fragment shown in place of a parser work count that the trace did not record.

data.name: MotifApp.DurationSecondsFormat
data.comment: A duration of one second or more, with one decimal place; {0} is the seconds, such as 1.5 s.

data.name: MotifApp.DurationMillisecondsFormat
data.comment: A duration from 10 milliseconds to under one second, in whole milliseconds; {0} is the milliseconds, such as 287 ms.

data.name: MotifApp.DurationSubMillisecondsFormat
data.comment: A duration under 10 milliseconds, with up to three decimal places; {0} is the milliseconds, such as 0.19 ms.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceDroppedPathsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# other path the parser tried and dropped (normal)} other {# other paths the parser tried and dropped (normal)}}
data.comment: Count sentence over the folded paths of a parsed word: other paths the parser tried and dropped, which is normal. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAttemptsFailedPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# attempt failed · choose a group to see its recorded outcomes} other {# attempts failed · choose a group to see its recorded outcomes}}
data.comment: Count sentence over the Try a Word stop groups. # is the number of failed attempts.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAttemptsPattern
data.comment: Count of attempts shown beside a Try a Word stop group. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsChangesNoun
data.comment: Lower-case noun in the Texts page's Proposal notes for the What Changed tab, as in 'This page shows today's changes between runs.'

data.name: MotifApp.TextsListsPairedNote
data.value: Each list chip and header reads the words the list holds today, then the words it holds with this Proposal, for the same words. A list counts words, so a list that reads the same on both sides can still hold different words. A chosen list shows the words either side puts in its cells, and the With This Proposal column says where the Proposal puts each one; the other columns are today's.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's Lists tab in the Today to Proposal view when both sides cover the same words.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsListsDifferentWordsNote
data.value: This Proposal's Trial measured different words from today's matrix, so nothing is paired and each list shows today's counts. A chosen list shows today's words; the With This Proposal column says where the Proposal puts each one, or that its try did not measure it.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's Lists tab in the Today to Proposal view when the Trial's words are not the words in today's matrix.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsListsViewNote
data.value: Each list chip and header reads the words with this Proposal. A chosen list shows the words the Proposal puts in its cells that today's matrix also has, with their FieldWorks analyses and what the Proposal's try made of them; a word only the Proposal's try measured is counted but not listed, and the line under the list says how many. The places are those of the words the Proposal puts in the list; today's parse is left to the Today view.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's Lists tab in the Proposal view.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsListsReadingNote
data.value: Reading this Proposal's counts. Until they arrive each list shows today's counts.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's Lists tab in the Today to Proposal view while the Proposal's counts are being read.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsWhatChangedReadingNote
data.value: Reading this Proposal's counts. Until they arrive this tab compares the last two runs.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's What Changed tab in the Today to Proposal view while the Proposal's counts are being read.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsWhatChangedPairedNote
data.value: Each move is the cell a word is in today and the cell the Proposal puts it in. Only words that today's matrix and the Proposal's try both have are compared; the words only one side has are counted under the summary and are never listed as moved. Today's own comparison of the last two runs shows in the Today view.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's What Changed tab in the Today to Proposal view.

data.name: MotifApp.TextsWhatChangedViewNote
data.value: These are the same moves as in Today → Proposal: each is the cell a word is in today and the cell the Proposal puts it in. Only words that today's matrix and the Proposal's try both have are compared; the words only one side has are counted under the summary and are never listed as moved. The Proposal's own cells are on the Matrix and Lists tabs.
data.comment: Note on the Texts page's What Changed tab in the Proposal view, which lists the words the Proposal moves as the pair does.
